title: rubberbacked rugs
text: rubberbacked rugs. These are not quite as plush or lux as I would have hoped... but they are rubber backed and say they are machine washable.  I have not done that yet - hopefully they'll fair well.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I chose the gray.  It is, in my opinion, a medium gray.  The rubber backing is an ivory color.  The stitching on the back looks... a little cheapy... but like I said.. we'll see!  There are 2... one larger like for a tub or shower front... one smaller - like in front of a sink or maybe a toilet.

features: DURABLE AND EXTRA SOFT: The bath rugs are made of 100% polyester, which is more durable than other mats. When you get out of bathtub, our bath mat offers a soft and warm place for your feet, and prevent them touching the cold and wet floor.

NON-SLIP MAT: On the back side of bath mat, there are several rows of polyester chains to prevent the slippery on the wet floor. Meanwhile, the backside design makes the bath rugs more breathable, that makes the mat ventilate and keep the floor under the mat drying fast.
MACHINE WASH AND DRY: The bath rug mat is light weight, and easy to clean. It can be washed by washing machine. Just using mild detergent and low setting on tumble dry is OK for the bath mat.
